case_title: Sangeeta Agraval & Ors. v. State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.498A, s.304B; Dowry Prohibition Act s.3/4
neutral_facts: The case involves an application filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking to quash the proceedings against the appellants. The application was dismissed by the High Court, and the appellants challenged this decision. The High Court failed to set out the facts of the case, which is necessary to understand the factual matrix and assess the legal challenge. The Supreme Court held that the High Court should have first outlined the brief facts of the case to evaluate the challenge to the proceedings. The case was remanded to the High Court for reconsideration on the merits.
